The target is target_bytes_per_person (Naz, 2026-10-25: about 50 KB a person, so 50,000 people in some 2.5 GB and 100,000 in 5 GB, beside the fixed overhead); bytes_per_person is the ceiling held now, lowered as each cut lands, to the target. Lowering it goes with the cut that earns it; raising it is a decision, with its entry in docs/decisions.md. Set 2026-10-25 on the Mini from main's build at 4 threads: 203 people peaked at 221 to 230 MB resident, 1,000 at 651 to 668 MB (two runs each), so about 110 MB fixed and 546 KB a person; the ceiling is the worst of those, 558 KB, and about 6% (run to run). Lowered to 480 KB with the streamed state hash (2026-10-26: 1,000 people 553 to 560 MB at 4 threads, 450 KB a person). Lowered to 410 KB with what's been seen held once (2026-10-26: 1,000 people 496 MB at 4 threads, 386 KB a person).
